metadata.source: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources — Land Information Ontario (LIO) Open Data, Bathymetry Line layer
metadata.depthUnits: metres, negative = depth below surface (contours digitized from a survey in 20 ft intervals: -6.1, -12.2, -18.3, -24.4 m, plus deep-basin contours at -31.1, -32, -33.5 m)
metadata.notes: 18 contour lines, filtered to features falling entirely within the Lake Kagawong shoreline polygon. Not for navigation.
